# Code of conduct

Syntropy Health is built for people looking after their own health and the health of the people they care for. We want
working on it to feel just as considerate.

## Our pledge

We pledge to make taking part in this project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size,
visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience,
education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our standards

Examples of behavior that helps:

- Being kind and patient, especially with people who are new to the project or to programming
- Respecting different viewpoints and experiences, and giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
- Owning mistakes and learning from them
- Focusing on what is best for the people who use Syntropy Health

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- Sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome attention or advances
- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks
- Public or private harassment
- Publishing others' private information, **including anyone's health information**, without their explicit permission
- Other conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting

## Scope

This code applies in all project spaces (issues, pull requests, discussions and other channels) and when someone
represents the project in public.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior to **contact@syntropylabs.io**. Every report is reviewed and investigated promptly and
fairly, and the reporter's privacy is respected. Maintainers may remove, edit or reject comments, commits, code, issues
and other contributions that don't follow this code, and may ban anyone from the project temporarily or permanently for
behavior they judge inappropriate.
